metadata.title: The Consilience of the QNFO Keyword Taxonomy: Ultrametric Structure as a Testable Compression Prior
metadata.description: The QNFO research program spans seven domains and maintains a canonical keyword taxonomy of 335 terms. This paper subjects the program's consilience claim to a computational audit of that vocabulary. The taxonomy is strictly partitional: 334 of 335 keywords occur in exactly one program, none in three or more. The consilience claim is a semantic claim carried by bridge families, cross-cutting themes, and corpus-level links. The paper states the revised claim, three falsifiable hypotheses with disconfirmation criteria, three practitioner-facing deliverables, and binds the strong form of the program to a 2028 decision point. All quantitative claims are computationally verified by a deterministic, seeded verification suite deposited with the paper.

title: The Consilience of the QNFO Keyword Taxonomy: Ultrametric Structure as a Testable Compression Prior
